title: Universality for two-dimensional critical cellular automata
notes: Classifies critical monotone update families in 2D and proves universal threshold-order behavior.

title: Sharp Metastability Threshold for Two-Dimensional Bootstrap Percolation
notes: Establishes the sharp threshold and critical droplet picture for the classic two-neighbor model.

title: Maximum percolation time in two-dimensional bootstrap percolation
notes: Optimizes slow-growth infection schedules and gives extremal running-time constructions.

title: Pattern Problems related to the Arithmetic Kakeya Conjecture
notes: Shows several pattern problems are equivalent to the arithmetic Kakeya conjecture and broadens the pattern viewpoint.
